The dashboard turns green when your speed is safe; the small pad multiplies the score by 5 and the fuel left adds to it. Gravity gets stronger with every mission.

Jeu d'adresse : pilote un module spatial: A skill game: fly a space module and land it gently on one of three pads before the fuel runs out. A game is 3 lives and a score that adds up, across five worlds: the Moon, windy Mars, icy Europa where you slide, an asteroid under a meteor shower, Titan and its thick air, with canyons and moving pads. Keyboard, mouse or gamepad, full screen. New: every landing is graded out of 12 (speed, angle, centring, fuel), from D to PERFECT; the real gravity of each body in m/s²; a fifth world, Titan, where the thick air slows everything.
